jobs.p1_hook: tall vertical picture: the main character sits at a small plain desk, seen from the front, holding one pen in its front paw raised just above a big open notebook that lies flat on the desk tilted toward the viewer; both pages of the notebook are completely blank, clean and empty, big and clearly visible; the cat leans in but hesitates, worried eyes, ears slightly back, a nervous little smile, the pen not touching the paper; its tail with the flame curls beside the chair. LAYOUT: the open notebook is big in the lower middle, about half the picture width, nothing lies on its pages and nothing covers them; the cat sits behind the desk, head and paws above the notebook; no letters or numbers anywhere.
jobs.p2_pile: tall vertical picture: a tall stack of five pretty colourful new notebooks stands on the floor; the main character sits beside the stack holding the top notebook open toward the viewer, its pages completely blank; the cat scratches its head with the other paw, a sheepish guilty smile. LAYOUT: the stack and the cat side by side, both big and whole; no letters or numbers anywhere.
jobs.p3_call: tall vertical picture: the main character sits on the floor facing the viewer, smiling warmly and kindly, holding out one simple pen toward the viewer in both front paws like a friendly offer; its tail flame burns bright. LAYOUT: the cat big and whole in the lower middle, the pen close to the viewer; no letters or numbers anywhere.
jobs.p4_museum: tall vertical picture: a funny metaphor: one open blank notebook lies on a tall white museum pedestal behind a red velvet rope on two little posts, softly glowing like a precious treasure; the main character stands timidly outside the rope, holding a pen at arm's length, afraid to come closer, wide worried eyes. LAYOUT: the pedestal with the glowing notebook on the right, the cat whole on the left, both big; no letters or numbers anywhere.
jobs.p5_scribble: tall vertical picture: the main character sits at a small plain desk and happily, boldly scribbles one big messy loopy spiral doodle across the first page of an open notebook with a pen, tongue out in concentration, bright cheerful eyes; the notebook lies flat tilted toward the viewer. LAYOUT: the open notebook big in the lower middle with the big spiral doodle on its left page, the cat behind the desk; the doodle is only loops, no letters or numbers anywhere.
jobs.p6_write: tall vertical picture: the main character sits relaxed at a small plain desk and writes in an open notebook with a pen, a calm happy proud face; the notebook pages are filled with wavy hand-drawn lines and tiny doodles, and on the left page there is one crooked funny little cat doodle; its tail flame burns big and golden with a few sparks. LAYOUT: the open notebook big in the lower middle, the cat behind the desk; the lines on the pages are only wavy strokes, no letters or numbers anywhere.
